the stochastic dynamic programming method was used to optimize the water resources management for the Nebhana dam in Tunisia.
the optimal water allocation rule is a function of the water storage volume and the decision period, and it permits to estimate the necessary volume to be released to satisfy the irrigation demand.
the optimal rule for the Nebhana dam would permit to estimate a water release volume for a given decision period and a given water storage.

the development of a model that would help the decision maker to improve the water management of the dam in arid zone.
the optimization of the water allocation in arid conditions by using the stochastic dynamic programming.
the development of a stochastic dynamic programming model for the optimization of the Nebhana reservoir water allocation.

the optimal rule for the water allocation of the Nebhana reservoir is based on the water storage and water inflows.
the optimal rule would permit a good water resources management of Nebhana dam.
